title: Introduction to Machine Learning
overview: Learn what machine learning is, where it is used, and how the full ML workflow looks from data to deployment.

title: Python for Machine Learning
overview: Build practical Python basics for ML using arrays, data frames, plotting, and notebooks.

title: Linear Algebra for ML
overview: Understand vectors, matrices, matrix multiplication, and decomposition used by almost all ML algorithms.

title: Statistics and Probability
overview: Learn probability distributions, expectation, variance, and statistical reasoning required for uncertainty and inference.

title: Data Collection and Preprocessing
overview: Prepare real world data by cleaning records, handling missing values, encoding categories, and scaling numeric features.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis
overview: Use descriptive statistics and plots to understand distributions, correlations, skew, class imbalance, and outliers before modeling.

title: Feature Engineering
overview: Create, transform, and select informative features to improve model performance and reduce overfitting.

title: Linear Regression
overview: Start supervised learning with linear regression for continuous prediction tasks.

title: Logistic Regression
overview: Learn binary classification with logistic regression and probability outputs.

title: Model Evaluation and Validation
overview: Evaluate models correctly with train validation test splits, metrics, and cross validation.

title: Decision Trees and Ensemble Methods
overview: Master powerful tabular data models such as decision trees, random forests, and gradient boosting.

title: Unsupervised Learning
overview: Learn pattern discovery without labels using clustering, density methods, and anomaly detection.

title: Dimensionality Reduction
overview: Reduce feature space for visualization, noise reduction, and faster training with PCA and related techniques.

title: Optimization and Gradient Descent
overview: Understand how models learn via gradients and why optimizer choice impacts convergence and stability.

title: Neural Networks Basics
overview: Build intuition for feedforward neural networks, activation functions, backpropagation, and training loops.

title: Regularization and Hyperparameter Tuning
overview: Improve generalization with regularization and systematic hyperparameter search.

title: Convolutional Neural Networks
overview: Learn image modeling with CNNs including convolution, pooling, and transfer learning basics.

title: Sequence Models: RNN and LSTM
overview: Model sequences with recurrent networks and understand how LSTM gates help long term dependencies.

title: Attention and Transformers
overview: Study modern sequence modeling with attention and transformer blocks used in language and multimodal models.

title: Time Series Forecasting
overview: Forecast temporal data with classical and ML methods while preserving timeline aware validation.

title: Recommender Systems
overview: Learn recommendation basics with collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, and ranking metrics.

title: Generative Models
overview: Study major generative model families including VAE, GAN, and diffusion models for content generation.

title: Alignment and RLHF
overview: Learn how human preference data is used to align model behavior using reward modeling and policy optimization.

title: MLOps and Deployment
overview: Move models to production with reproducible pipelines, testing, monitoring, and retraining workflows.

title: Responsible AI and Ethics
overview: Build safe and trustworthy systems by evaluating fairness, robustness, privacy, and explainability.

title: End to End ML Capstone
overview: Consolidate learning by completing one end to end project from data ingestion to deployment and monitoring.
